description: This file contains utility functions for managing rebaselines, including adding, clearing, applying suggested rebaselines, creating patches, and finding git root directories. It also includes logic for applying patches with conflict markers, and handles file I/O and diff operations within the Playwright test framework.

methods.name: addSuggestedRebaseline
methods.description: Adds a suggested rebaseline replacement at a specific location.

methods.name: applySuggestedRebaselines
methods.description: Applies all suggested rebaselines to files, creating patches or overwriting files based on configuration.

methods.name: createPatch
methods.description: Creates a diff patch between two file contents.

methods.name: findGitRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the git repository.

methods.name: applyPatchWithConflictMarkers
methods.description: Applies a diff with conflict markers to handle merge conflicts.
